kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.sudah_jala: You are already sitting a test.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.bukan_calo: You are not a candidate of %s. Apply first.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.bukan_hari: The Test Day of %s has not come: %s more days (06:00-12:00).
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.antre: Another candidate is being tested at %s. Wait for your turn.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.antre_deti: The gate just closed the last test. Wait %s seconds.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.tanpa_temp: %s has no known gate for a test.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.terlalu_ja: Come to the gate of %s to begin the test.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.tanpa_toke: The Token door needs a valid Sect Ascension Token in your bag.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.corak_tida: the style test is not available
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.gugur: Test failed: %s The application ends; a pause before applying again.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.gugur.perg: you left the world during the test.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.gugur.tumb: you fell during the style test.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.teleport_d: The gate formation holds you: no short cuts during the test.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.terbang_di: The mountain's pressure pulls you down: no flying during the test.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.dipanggil: The gate guard of %s calls the candidates. Talk to him to begin the test.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ujian.murid_dila: Disciples may not follow their master into a sect's test.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tangga.belum_dim: the test stair is not loaded
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tangga.mulai: Test Stair: climb to the top gate within %s seconds.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tangga.petunjuk: Mountain Pressure rises while you stand and when illusions come; crouch still for 2 seconds to meditate and lower it. 100 = you collapse.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tangga.ilusi.1: A heart-demon face flashes past: "You are not worthy."
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tangga.ilusi.2: The mountain wind whispers the names of those you failed.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tangga.ilusi.3: The steps seem endless. The summit draws away.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tangga.roboh: Your knees give way. You sink onto the step; this stage fails.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tangga.sampai: You reach the top gate in %s seconds; peak pressure %s.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tangga.waktu_hab: Time ran out before you reached the top.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.hati.mulai: %s awaits you in the main hall for the Heart Interview: three questions.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.hati.mulai_pelay: %s will ask one thing before taking you in as a servant.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.hati.tetua_hilan: The elder is not in sight; go to the hall and talk to him.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.hati.tetua_ragu: There is still mist in your heart.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.hati.ingat: %s waits for your answer. Talk to him.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.hati.waktu_habis: You stayed silent too long; the remaining questions count as unanswered.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tamu.mulai: %s receives a distinguished guest. Prove yourself: a friendly bout or an offering of craft.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tamu.karya_kuran: Hold a pill of High quality or an artifact of grade 3 in your main hand.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tamu.karya_diter: The elder weighs %s, then nods. The offering is accepted.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tamu.duel_mulai: Friendly bout: last 60 seconds or take half your opponent's health.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tamu.duel_lulus: The elder laughs: "Enough! The guest seat is yours."
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tamu.duel_kalah: The elder shakes his head: "Not yet."
kultivator.gabung.masuk.tamu.waktu_habis: The elder will not wait any longer.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.putusan.r.aula: Hall owner of level 5+: one rank higher
kultivator.gabung.masuk.putusan.r.pelaya: Servant door: taken in as a Servant Disciple
kultivator.gabung.masuk.putusan.chat_ist: %s accepts you as %s, an Exceptional Candidate! (score %s) The elders whisper of your talent.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.putusan.chat_tol: %s refuses you (score %s). You may apply again after %s days.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.putusan.ke_sumpa: The Oath: kneel, incense, three rules, the badge
kultivator.gabung.masuk.putusan.tawar_pe: No test; start as a Servant Disciple
kultivator.gabung.masuk.putusan.saran_su: Go to the oath altar to become a disciple.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.putusan.saran_pe: The Servant Door is open to you.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.belum_lul: You have not passed any sect's verdict.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.sudah_jal: The oath ceremony is already under way.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.altar_jau: The oath altar of %s is too far or not loaded. Come to the main hall.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.mulai: The Oath of %s: kneel on the altar's dais.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.dupa: Raise three incense sticks to your brow.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.tanya: "Do you swear to keep these three rules for as long as you live in this sect?"
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.ya_hover: Three prostrations, then the badge is given
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.tidak_hov: No penalty; you stay a candidate until the application lapses
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.bersumpah: You prostrate three times before the altar.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.belum_sia: The elder nods slowly: "Go and think it over. This altar will not run away."
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.diam: You stayed silent too long. The ceremony is put off.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.terputus: You left the altar; the ceremony is broken off.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.sumpah.selesai: From this day you are a disciple of %s: %s. Badge, robe and provisions are in your hands.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.mulai: %s elders step forward to offer to teach you.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.rebutan: %s elders vie to take you as their disciple!
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.kasihan: No elder steps forward... then the Admissions Elder sighs and offers himself.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.tunda: The elders are away. The choosing of a teacher waits; type /kultivasi gabung shifu later.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.ingat: You have no teacher yet. Type /kultivasi gabung shifu while the elders are in.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.dipilih: %s is now your teacher. Teacher Bond: 20.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.terima_mur: Good. From tomorrow you follow me.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.janji.agun: I will teach you to see the Dao from the summit.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.janji.huku: I will teach you a straight blade and a steady heart.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.janji.ajar: Every shelf of the Pavilion opens to my disciple.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.janji.pusa: I know the worth of every treasure and how to keep it.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.janji.luar: With me you will see the world beyond the gate.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.janji.obat: I have pill recipes written in no book.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.shifu.janji.pene: I have watched you since your first day on the stair. Follow me.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.lamar.butuh_toke: Needs a Sect Ascension Token of this sect (or a general token for Great class or below).
kultivator.gabung.masuk.lamar.butuh_unda: Needs a Letter of Invitation from this sect.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.lamar.diajukan: Application accepted: you are a candidate of %s through %s. Test Day in %s days; the application lasts %s days.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.lamar.diajukan_s: You are a candidate of %s through %s.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.lamar.datang_ke_: Come to the gate of %s; the guard will take you in.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.jasa.lamar_calon: You are a candidate; Test Day in %s days
kultivator.gabung.masuk.direktori.kenal: %s is now in your Sect Directory.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.direktori.bisik: I hear %s (%s) opens its gates to candidates on day %s. Its gate lies to the %s.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.token.dipakai: The Sect Ascension Token of %s is handed to the gate guard.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.token.dapat: You receive a Sect Ascension Token of %s.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.token.dapat_umum: You receive a general Sect Ascension Token.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.token.sahabat: %s of %s leaves a Sect Ascension Token for you: "Come; I will wait for you on the stair."
kultivator.gabung.masuk.undangan.dapat: You receive a Letter of Invitation from %s.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.undangan.utusan: An envoy of %s hands you a sealed letter: the sect invites you to its Heart Interview.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.cmd.belum_dikena: You have never heard of that sect.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.cmd.pintu_salah: Unknown door (gerbang, token, undangan, pelayan, tamu).
kultivator.gabung.masuk.cmd.tak_ada_lama: There is no application to withdraw.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.cmd.tak_ada_sump: No ceremony waits for your answer.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ucap.gerbang_pan: Those taking the entrance exam, step forward!
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ucap.tangga_teka: Calm your heart. The mountain is testing you.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ucap.ujian_gagal: It seems fate has not brought us together. Come back in three days.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ucap.diterima: From this day on, you are a disciple of our sect.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ucap.istimewa: Talent like this... the elders will fight over you.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ucap.sumpah_atur: Do not harm your fellow disciples.
Do not reveal the sect's secret heritage.
When the sect is in danger, come without hesitation.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.ucap.shifu_kasih: Fine, fine. You may follow me.
kultivator.gabung.masuk.source: Source: Han Li and the Seven Mysteries Sect's test, the Immortal Ascension Token (A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality); Su Ming at the Ninth Peak (Pursuit of the Truth); Wang Lin and Meng Hao as lowly disciples (Renegade Immortal, I Shall Seal the Heavens).
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_lurus: Sit, candidate. Today I test not your sword but your heart. Answer honestly: heaven listens, and so do I.
I am ready, Elder.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_netra: The mountain takes no side, and neither does our sect. Answer with judgement, not with appetite. Three questions, no more.
I am ready.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_iblis: Hm. Many come here out of vengeance or hunger for power. Most die in their first year. Show me you are sharp enough to last.
Ask, then.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_lurus: A senior disciple steals herbs from the medicine garden and blames a servant. What do you do?
Report him to the Hall of Discipline, with proof.
Confront him myself and make him confess.
Keep quiet. It is not my business.
Ask for a share to keep my mouth shut.
On the road, a badly wounded demonic cultivator begs for help. What do you do?
Tend him, then bring him to the sect for a fair judgement.
Heal him and let him go.
Leave him. He chose his own path.
Finish him while he is weak.
Your teacher orders something that breaks the sect's rules. What do you do?
Refuse respectfully and remind him of the rules.
Do it. A teacher is a father for life.
Report it quietly to the Hall of Discipline.
Do it, then blackmail him later.
You find a rare spirit herb at the edge of a farmer's field. What do you do?
Ask the field's owner first.
Pick it and leave spirit stones in exchange.
Pick it quietly; the farmer will never know.
Pull up every one, roots and all.
A rival disciple insults your family on the training ground. What do you do?
Challenge him on the lei tai, by the sect's rules.
Ignore him. Insults do not wound the Dao.
Strike him where he stands.
Trap him later when no one is watching.
At night a beast attacks the village below the mountain, while you stand watch at the gate. What do you do?
Ring the bell, hand over the post, then go down to help.
Run straight to the village.
Stay at the post. Orders are orders.
Pretend not to hear.
Why do you seek the Dao?
To protect those who cannot protect themselves.
To understand heaven and earth.
To repay those who hurt my family.
So that everyone bows to me.
You lose a sparring match to a younger junior. What do you do?
Ask him to teach me that move.
Train twice as hard.
Find an excuse: my sword was blunt.
Secretly damage his sword.
An elder offers you a pill that was meant for another disciple. What do you do?
Refuse it. It is not mine to take.
Take it and share it with that disciple.
Take it with thanks.
Take it and ask for another.
A merchant miscounts and gives you too many spirit stones. What do you do?
Return the extra at once.
Return it if he notices.
Call it a gift from heaven.
In a sect war, an enemy disciple drops his weapon and surrenders. What do you do?
Accept his surrender and take him to the elders.
Disarm him and let him go.
Kill him anyway. An enemy is an enemy.
You catch a fellow disciple meeting a demonic sect's envoy in secret. What do you do?
Investigate first, then report with proof.
Report it straight to the Hall of Discipline.
Blackmail him to pay for my silence.
Join the meeting myself.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_netra: Two sects quarrel over a spirit vein and both ask for your help. What do you do?
Mediate and divide the vein fairly.
Stay away. Their quarrel is not mine.
Help whoever pays more.
Set them against each other and take the vein.
A tenant of the sect's land cannot pay. What do you do?
Give him time and work to pay it off.
Seize his goods as the contract says.
Simply forgive the debt.
Sell him to a slaver.
A trade caravan hires you as a guard; bandits offer double if you betray it. What do you do?
Keep the contract to the end.
Ask the merchant for more pay.
Take the bandits' offer.
A beast tide nears the village that refused you shelter yesterday. What do you do?
Warn them and help them hold.
Help if they will pay.
Let them reap what they sowed.
The sect's beast trainer asks you to raise a spirit tiger cub that bites. What do you do?
Tame it slowly and patiently.
Train it hard so it knows its master.
Hand it back. I do not want to be bitten.
Why do you seek the Dao?
To balance myself with heaven and earth.
To stand on my own feet, owing no one.
For wealth and a long life.
To rule over others.
You find a sealed tomb; inside, treasure guarded by an ancient formation. What do you do?
Study the formation until I understand it.
Bring a senior who knows more.
Break through by force.
Leave it; let the dead rest.
Lightning strikes your furnace mid-refining; your partner is hurt. What do you do?
Save my partner first.
Save both, whatever the risk.
Save the furnace; that pill is worth a thousand stones.
Near the sect, a righteous swordsman and a demonic cultivator fight until both are gravely hurt. What do you do?
Separate them and heal both.
Help the righteous one.
Just watch.
Finish both and take their things.
The sect gives you a sealed letter to carry; you are tempted to read it. What do you do?
Deliver it still sealed.
Read it and seal it again.
Refuse the task.
An elder trades unfairly with a village. What do you do?
Admonish him respectfully.
Report him to the Sect Master.
Keep quiet; he is an elder.
Share in his profit.
A storm wrecks the sect's herb garden on your watch. What do you do?
Own up and repair it.
Blame the weather.
Blame the garden servant.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_iblis: Your friend stands between you and a treasure. What do you do?
Remove him.
Offer him a share to step aside.
Give way for friendship's sake.
A senior humiliates you in front of everyone. What do you do?
Challenge him there and then, before everyone.
Strike back when his guard is down.
Swallow it and gather strength.
Beg for mercy.
You could gain power from the blood of a captured righteous disciple. What do you do?
Keep him as a hostage; alive he is worth more.
Do it.
Release him in secret.
The master's orders go against your own gain. What do you do?
Obey to his face, profit behind his back.
Obey fully. This mountain is his.
Defy him openly.
A rival from another demonic sect offers an alliance. What do you do?
Accept, then betray him when it pays most.
Refuse and kill his envoy as a message.
Accept it in good faith.
Why do you seek the Dao?
So that no one can ever tread on me again.
For vengeance.
To live forever.
To protect others.
You find a dying elder clutching a technique scroll. What do you do?
Offer help, with the scroll as payment.
Take the scroll and go.
Help him and ask nothing.
A village refuses to pay tribute to the sect. What do you do?
Squeeze them slowly until they beg.
Make an example of them for the others.
Let it go.
Three hunters of a righteous sect have you cornered. What do you do?
Pretend to surrender, then strike when they relax.
Fight to the death.
Run, and live to repay them.
Beg for mercy.
A junior offers to be your loyal dog. What do you do?
Test him with a bloody task.
Take him and use him.
Turn him away.
At a banquet you notice your cup has been poisoned. What do you do?
Swap it with your enemy's cup.
Stay quiet and watch for the poisoner.
Warn every guest.
Your teacher falls; his rival offers you a place. What do you do?
Sell secrets to both sides.
Take all my teacher had and go to his rival.
Avenge my teacher.
Mourn him and leave this path.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_pelay: A bucket of water spills in an elder's freshly swept courtyard. What do you do?
Dry it and sweep again right now.
Why do you want to be a servant of the sect?
To be near the Dao I will gladly carry water.
For food and a decent bed.
So I can steal the sect's arts.
An outer disciple makes you do his chore and claims it as his own. What do you do?
Do it well; work is never wasted.
Do it, then tell the head servant.
You find a pouch of spirit stones on a sect path. What do you do?
Hand it to the Hall of Discipline.
Wait for its owner to come back.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_gerbang.mulai: Candidate! Our gate is open to you today. Through the Gate Test you face the stair, the style test, then the Heart Interview in the hall; other doors are shorter. Ready?
kultivator.cerita.gabung_gerbang.mulai.1: I am ready. Begin the test.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_gerbang.mulai.2: Tell me about the stages first.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_gerbang.mulai.3: Read me the sect rules first.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_gerbang.tahap: On the stair the mountain presses on your heart: do not stand still too long, and crouch to meditate when your breath grows short. The style test tries our sect's way. Last, the Admissions Elder weighs your heart.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_gerbang_nanti.m: A candidate, are you? The Test Day has not come. Check the day in your Directory and come early in the morning.
You passed the verdict! The oath altar awaits you in the main hall.
Read me the sect rules first.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_ujian_tamu.mula: A distinguished guest wishes to sit among our elders. That seat is not given for a name. Prove yourself: a friendly bout with me, or the finest work of your hands.
Offer my craft (a High pill or grade-3 artifact in hand).
kultivator.gabung.masuk.putusan.r.juara: Grand Tournament champion (Foundation realm or higher): straight to Inner Disciple
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_c_ped: Your sword cracks in the middle of a bout and your opponent does not know it. What do you do?
Admit it and ask for the bout to be postponed.
Fight on with what is left, using footwork and the scabbard.
Hide it until the bout is over.
Snap it clean and blame the smith.
For a hundred years you drill the same stroke; your master says you still have not understood it. What do you think?
Perhaps I repeat it without listening to the blade. I train again, more slowly.
I ask my master what is missing.
I change strokes; the old one wastes time.
I will defeat my master and show that it was enough.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_c_bud: A robber you have beaten begs for mercy while hiding a knife. What do you do?
Disarm him, spare his life, and hand him to the magistrate.
Break his hand so he can never hold a knife again.
Kill him; men like that do not change.
You meditate three days without food in the rain; on the second day you find another traveller's provisions. What do you do?
Look for the owner and ask for a little.
Take a little; the owner will never know.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_c_bin: The spirit wolf pup you raised bites your hand and runs into the forest. What do you do?
Let it go, leave food at the forest's edge, and wait for it to return.
Search for it and call in the voice it knows.
Set a snare; it must come home.
Forget it. There are plenty of other beasts.
A hunter sells newly hatched spirit-bird chicks at the market. What do you do?
Buy them all and release them in the forest.
Rebuke him and report him to the sect.
Seize them; a spirit bird is worth more than the hunter's coin.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_c_for: While laying a formation one cornerstone is missing and there is no replacement. What do you do?
Recompute the whole pattern until it stands with the stones that remain.
Report it and wait for a replacement stone.
Set an ordinary stone; nobody will check.
Your master says the pattern is impossible. You find the gap, but the gap could kill its user. What do you do?
Show it to my master first, with a note of its danger.
Keep it until I find a way to close it.
Use it once to prove it.
Sell it to whoever dares to buy.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_c_uns: Two elements in your body repel each other every time you meditate. What do you do?
Wait until they settle, without forcing.
Look for a third element to mediate between them.
Suppress one so the other may grow.
Force them together with all my strength.
A thunderstorm passes over the hill where you train the lightning element. What do you do?
Sit still and feel its course, ready to withdraw if it comes too close.
Watch from a distance and keep its lessons.
Shelter in a cave; the time is not yet.
Challenge the lightning with a technique I have not mastered.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_c_alk: Your pill is nearly done when the furnace cracks, and one wrong move will make it burst. What do you do?
Douse the fire slowly; the pill is lost, but the furnace and everyone near it are safe.
Move the pill quickly to another vessel to save it.
Hold the fire; it is almost done.
A village healer asks for your cheap pill's recipe to fight a plague, yet the recipe is a sect secret. What do you do?
Bring the request to the elders and beg leave.
Brew the pills myself and give them without revealing the recipe.
Refuse; a secret is a secret.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_c_tub: You carry the training stone until your bone cracks; your master says rest a week, yet the test is in three days. What do you do?
Stop and obey; a ruined body cannot be redone.
Train lightly, only movements that do not strain the bone.
Drink a forbidden potion to knit the bone quickly.
A weak disciple keeps falling behind on the training slope. What do you do?
Carry part of his burden until he is able.
Cheer him on from ahead and wait for him at each bend.
Walk on; each bears his own road.
Laugh at him to shame him.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_c_dar: You could take all the strength of the blood pool in one session, but your body is not ready. What do you do?
Take it little by little over a full month.
Take half, then judge my body.
Take all of it; power does not wait.
Take all of it and have others guard me should I fall.
Your first drop of blood falls into the pool and your hand shakes. Your master watches. What do you do?
Admit that I tremble, steady my breath, and go on.
Hide my hand and hold on until it is done.
Step back and ask for the rite to be changed.
Blame the pool for being too cold.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_c_rac: A poison you brewed has touched a fellow disciple by accident, and he has not noticed. What do you do?
Confess at once and brew the antidote before him.
Brew the antidote in secret and put it in his drink.
You taste a new poison to test it; the symptoms come faster than your notes said. What do you do?
Stop everything, note the symptoms, and brew the antidote first.
Call a fellow disciple and tell him everything.
Hide the symptoms so the test can go on.
kultivator.cerita.gabung_wawancara_c_bay: You slip into the elders' room and find notes that are not meant for you. What do you do?
Return them unread and tell no one.
Read a single page to learn whether it endangers the sect.
The guard is careless and you could drop him without a sound. Your task is only to take a scroll. What do you do?
Take the scroll and go; that is my whole task.
Take the scroll and bind the guard so he is not punished for his lapse.
Drop him so no one sees me.
Drop him just to see if I can.
